name: insurance-data-model
title: Insurance Operational Data Model
description: Normalized operational data model covering P&C personal, P&C commercial, life & annuity, and health insurance, following US market conventions (NAIC annual statement lines, state jurisdictions, ACORD/ISO/X12-style coding).

conventions.naming: snake_case, singular entity names. Surrogate keys are named <entity>_id and typed uuid. Reference tables are keyed by their natural code.
conventions.money: All 'money' attributes are in the currency of the owning policy, billing account or reinsurance contract (currency_code on that entity; USD by default).
conventions.percent: 'percent' attributes hold percentage points (12.5 means 12.5%). 'rate' attributes hold raw multipliers or per-unit rates.
conventions.time: 'date' attributes are business dates in the governing jurisdiction. 'timestamp' attributes are UTC instants.
conventions.versioning: Policy contents are versioned by transaction: every row of a policy child entity records the policy_transaction that added it and, if applicable, the one that removed it, plus the business-effective date range. The state of a policy at any date, as known at any time, is reconstructable.
conventions.financials: Premium, claim, account-value and reinsurance financials are append-only ledgers of signed amounts. Corrections are made with reversing entries (reverses_*_id), never updates. Balances such as outstanding reserve or earned premium are derived, not stored.
conventions.parties: Every person or organization exists once in 'party'. Involvement in a policy, claim, account or contract is expressed through role entities (policy_party, claim_party, ...), never by copying names and addresses.
conventions.subtypes: Line-specific detail lives in subtype entities sharing the supertype's primary key (subtypeOf). The core never needs to change to add a line of business.
conventions.externalCodes: Industry code sets (ICD-10, CPT/HCPCS, NAICS, NCCI/ISO class codes, WCIO, CARC/RARC, ...) are stored in code_set/code_value and referenced by code_value_id.
conventions.sensitivity: Attributes holding regulated data are tagged: PII (personal identifiers), PHI (HIPAA protected health information), PCI (payment card/bank data), SPI (other sensitive personal information).

string.description: Short text; maxLength may be given on the attribute (default 255).

audit.description: Row-level audit columns, applied to every entity by default.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User or system that created the row.

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.description: When the row was last changed.

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: User or system that last changed the row.

attributes.name: row_version
attributes.description: Optimistic-locking counter, incremented on every update.

policy_versioned.description: Transaction-based versioning for entities that make up the contents of a policy.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: First business date this row applies.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Business date this row stops applying (exclusive); null while open-ended.

attributes.name: added_by_transaction_id
attributes.description: Policy transaction that introduced this row.

attributes.name: removed_by_transaction_id
attributes.description: Policy transaction that removed or superseded this row.
